title: PremiumCMS seed section
description: A reusable content block (Manage → Sections in the admin). Layout sections `site-header` and `site-footer` hold the designer-editable chrome; their html may contain EMPTY marker elements the platform fills at build time: [data-menu="<name>"], [data-widget-area="<name>"], [data-theme-switcher]. Lives in seed/sections/<slug>.json; `slug` defaults to the filename.
